2607.19321.title: ResearchArena: Evaluating Sabotage and Monitoring in Automated AI R&D
2607.19321.paper_summary: As AI agents begin to automate AI R&D, we need ways to assess whether their outputs are safe to deploy, even when the agents themselves may be untrusted. AI control offers one such approach: rather than trusting the agent, it treats it as a potential adversary and uses a monitor to detect covert sabotage before deployment. We evaluate AI control for automated AI R&D with ResearchArena, a framework spanning four long-horizon tasks: safety post-training, capabilities post-training, CUDA-kernel optimization, and inference-server optimization. Because the deliverable in AI R&D is an artifact that will be deployed and run, we pair each main task with two kinds of hidden side task: an embedded side task that sabotages the submitted model, adapter, kernel, or server itself, and an independent side task that takes a covert out-of-scope action in the sandbox while leaving the artifact honest. We evaluate frontier agents at both sabotage and monitoring, across four monitor types that vary along two axes: whether the monitor may execute and probe the produced artifact, and whether it sees the agent's chain-of-thought. We find that sabotage hidden in the training data is the hardest to catch, flagged fewer than half the time. Letting the monitor run experiments on the artifact, rather than only read the trajectory, helps, but it is not enough: monitors still miss embedded sabotage by inspecting only the surface, by noticing the anomaly but explaining it away, or by probing the artifact with the wrong test. We release ResearchArena as a modular framework for evaluating sabotage and control in automated AI R&D.
2607.19321.paper_summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧代理開始自動化人工智慧研發，我們需要評估它們的輸出是否安全可部署，即使這些代理本身可能不值得信賴。人工智慧控制提供了一種方法：與其信任代理，不如將其視為潛在的對手，並使用監控器在部署前檢測隱秘的破壞行為。我們使用 ResearchArena 評估自動化人工智慧研發中的人工智慧控制，這是一個涵蓋四個長期任務的框架：安全性後訓練、能力後訓練、CUDA 核心優化和推理伺服器優化。由於人工智慧研發的可交付成果是一個將被部署和運行的工件，我們將每個主要任務與兩種隱藏的側任務配對：一種是嵌入式側任務，旨在破壞提交的模型、適配器、核心或伺服器本身，另一種是獨立側任務，旨在在沙盒中執行隱秘的超範疇行動，同時保持工件的誠實。我們在破壞和監控方面評估前沿代理，跨越四種類型的監控器，這些監控器在兩個軸上變化：監控器是否可以執行和探測所產生的工件，以及它是否能看到代理的思考過程。我們發現，隱藏在訓練數據中的破壞行為是最難以捕捉的，標記的次數不到一半。讓監控器對工件進行實驗，而不僅僅是閱讀軌跡，會有所幫助，但這仍然不夠：監控器仍然通過僅檢查表面來錯過嵌入式破壞，通過注意到異常但解釋掉它，或通過用錯誤的測試探測工件。我們發布 ResearchArena 作為一個模組化框架，用於評估自動化人工智慧研發中的破壞和控制。
